title: c4-view — a JSON model in, a gated deterministic diagram out

levels.title: C1 · who asks, what answers, what it touches

nodes.label: Agent or owner
nodes.desc: Writes the model, runs the CLI, reads the audit line back. Never edits a drawing by hand.

nodes.label: c4-view
nodes.desc: Turns a JSON model into a deterministic drawing, a gate and a read-only viewer.

nodes.label: Git repository
nodes.desc: Holds docs/c4/<id>.json, the docs beside it, and — if the owner said yes once — the hook.

nodes.label: Agent harness
nodes.desc: Where the skill is installed: a directory of instructions another tool reads.

nodes.label: Reader
nodes.desc: Opens the link, pans, zooms, hovers a box. The viewer is read-only by construction.

edges.desc: The agent hands over model.json: nodes, edges and their levels, and nothing else.
edges.label: model.json

edges.desc: The committed model and its per-element docs, read so a render never disagrees with the repo.
edges.label: model + docs

edges.desc: The drawn SVG and the gate verdict, written back so a reviewer sees the picture in the diff.
edges.label: SVG + gate

edges.desc: The skill package an agent loads, so it writes models that survive the audit.
edges.label: skill package

edges.desc: Self-contained HTML and SVG pages that open with no server and no network.
edges.label: SVG pages

nodes.label: c4v CLI
nodes.desc: One-shot process: parse, lay out, audit, write, and exit with the verdict.

nodes.label: viewer server
nodes.desc: Serves the pictures it already has, behind a token. Never writes a diagram.

nodes.label: viewer app
nodes.desc: Zoom, hover, drill and the flow animation. Client side, no build step.

nodes.label: diagram store
nodes.desc: Published models and their docs; also the repo's own docs/c4 while the CLI works.

nodes.label: git hook
nodes.desc: Three lines of shell in the user's repo. It owns no judgement.

edges.desc: A pre-commit check asks the CLI whether the staged model is still clean.
edges.label: gate check

edges.desc: A finished diagram is published into the store as one directory per model.
edges.label: publishes

edges.desc: The same binary starts the viewer, bound to the name and port it was given.
edges.label: starts

edges.desc: Every request reads one model directory: the server holds no state of its own between them.
edges.label: reads

edges.desc: The HTML shell, its stylesheets and the flow driver, served as files rather than built.
edges.label: HTML + JS

nodes.label: Args + dispatch
nodes.desc: Reads the command line, refuses what cannot work, and calls one verb.

nodes.label: Model parse
nodes.desc: Validates the model: ids, subtypes, ranks, ports, direction. Refuses rather than guesses.

nodes.label: Rank
nodes.desc: Longest-path depth, one dummy per column a long edge crosses.

nodes.label: Order
nodes.desc: Six barycentre sweeps; the ordering with fewest inversions wins.

nodes.label: Place
nodes.desc: Measures boxes, spaces columns by wire load, stacks rows, boxes up boundaries.

nodes.label: Route
nodes.desc: Orthogonal wires in gutters, one track per jog, a corridor for the loops.

nodes.label: Emit
nodes.desc: Deterministic SVG: shapes, chips, the dashed lens frame, the drill links.

nodes.label: Audit
nodes.desc: Counts what a reader would trip over, and the four modelling gates.

nodes.label: Repo gate
nodes.desc: install, check, defer, status, uninstall — the commit-time contract.

nodes.label: Publish
nodes.desc: Copies a model and its docs into the store the server reads.

edges.desc: The model path and the flags, handed to the parser that either accepts the model or names what is wrong.
edges.label: model.json

edges.desc: The staged files, checked before anything is drawn so a bad commit fails early.
edges.label: gate check

edges.desc: A validated level: nodes with their subtypes, edges with their descriptions, groups.
edges.label: LevelSpec

edges.desc: Ranked layers, so a box never lands left of something it depends on.
edges.label: Ranked

edges.desc: A stable order inside each rank, which is what keeps two runs byte-identical.
edges.label: Ordered

edges.desc: Measured boxes: every node sized to its text before a single line is drawn.
edges.label: Placed

edges.desc: Routed edges with their lanes, jogs and label boxes, ready to be written as paths.
edges.label: Routed

edges.desc: The same routed geometry, measured for overlaps and crossings rather than drawn.
edges.label: Routed

edges.desc: The finished SVG, one picture per level, written into the output directory.
edges.label: SVG

edges.desc: Where the files go and in which format, decided before the layout starts.
edges.label: publish

nodes.label: Guard
nodes.desc: One token: query, header or cookie. Refreshes a stale cookie, never prints the token to a log.

nodes.label: Routes
nodes.desc: The URL table: pages, API, assets. Every reply carries the same security headers.

nodes.label: Viewer page
nodes.desc: Server-renders the canvas, the level picker and the zoom presets before any script runs.

nodes.label: Hover docs
nodes.desc: One markdown file per node and edge, re-keyed for the level being drawn.

nodes.label: Diagram API
nodes.desc: List, fetch, publish. Refuses a body over the limit instead of buffering it.

nodes.label: Store reader
nodes.desc: Reads the published models off disk; a missing directory is an empty list, not an error.

nodes.label: Viewer app
nodes.desc: Zoom, hover, drill, and one edge animating at a time.

edges.desc: An admitted request: the token matched, or the bind is loopback and needs none.
edges.label: allowed

edges.desc: A level path from the URL, resolved against the model before a page is built.
edges.label: level

edges.desc: The authored doc for each node and edge on this level, embedded for hover.
edges.label: hover

edges.desc: A JSON request, answered with the model or the audit rather than a page.
edges.label: JSON

edges.desc: The stored models, listed so an agent can see what the viewer already holds.
edges.label: models

edges.desc: The one model this page draws, read fresh on every request.
edges.label: model

edges.desc: HTML, CSS and the flow driver, sending the whole picture on first paint.
edges.label: HTML + JS
